Conventional amphotericin B is licensed for use by intravenous infusion over at least 2 hours. A long infu- sion time is inconvenient for outpatients and often impractical in patients receiving other intravenous medications. This may be overcome by using one of the lipid formulations that can be infused over 30 to 120 minutes.
